# Build dependencies for the released executables, pinned to exact versions
# with hashes. CI installs them with --require-hashes --only-binary=:all:, so
# a package that changes on PyPI (a hijacked release, a re-uploaded file)
# fails the build instead of ending up inside an exe that ships to victims
# with build attestation attached.
#
# This is not requirements.txt. That file is for people running unmicro.py
# (or python -m unmicro_app) from source and stays loose on purpose.
#
# To update, list the direct dependencies in packaging/build.in and regenerate:
#   pip install uv
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.12 --generate-hashes \
#     --no-header --annotation-style line --only-binary :all: packaging/build.in -o requirements-build.txt
# build.in: pyinstaller, pycryptodome, filetype (the engine); PySide6-Essentials
# (the window), pillow (the icon, build time only), psutil (machine readings).
# --universal keeps the Windows-only packages (pefile, pywin32-ctypes) in,
# otherwise the Windows build fails the hash check.
